## Description

Speakers panel: each provisional speaker (A/B/C) with suggested identity and reason (device owner voice profile, answers to "Meera", consent roster), talk share, Confirm. Tags Doctor / Patient? / Companion? are dashed until confirmed. Transcript shows original language beside translation; edits to transcript text are tracked.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Speaker labels remain provisional until the doctor confirms; a speaker label never asserts patient identity automatically.
- [ ] **AC2.** Family members never inherit the patient identity; statements by a companion are attributed to the companion.
- [ ] **AC3.** Confirmations are recorded with actor and time and propagate to draft attribution.
- [ ] **AC4.** Transcript edits are versioned and visible in the evidence panel.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
